title: Psychology Study Platform
description: An interactive, AI-powered learning system with dynamic flashcards, intelligent quizzes, and smart study guide generation — designed for deep cognitive retention.

caseStudy.story: Built during late-night study sessions fueled by one question: What if studying psychology wasn't painful? Most digital study tools were static, repetitive, and cognitively flat. I wanted something that adapted to how humans actually learn.
caseStudy.problem: Traditional flashcards don't adapt to a student's current knowledge state. Students review what they already know, wasting time and losing retention. There was no intelligent study companion that understood context.
caseStudy.architecture: Integrated Claude AI API as an intelligent tutor layer. The system dynamically generates contextual flashcards, creates adaptive quizzes based on previous answer patterns, and produces personalized study guides. Built entirely with vanilla HTML/CSS/JS — proof that powerful AI experiences don't require heavy frameworks.
caseStudy.challenges: Optimizing API call latency while maintaining a smooth UX. Designing prompts that consistently produced structured, educationally valid output. Building an adaptive scoring system without a backend — using client-side state management exclusively.
caseStudy.impact: Transformed passive study into active AI-guided learning. Demonstrated that a single developer with AI tools can build what would traditionally require a full product team.
caseStudy.lessons: AI can transform passive consumption into active engagement. Prompt design is as critical as code design. Simplicity of stack ≠ simplicity of product.

title: Attendify — Attendance Platform
description: A highly organized web-based platform for structured attendance data tracking. Engineered with a clean UI to manage real-time attendance logistics seamlessly.

caseStudy.story: A problem I experienced firsthand every semester — no clean, fast way to track attendance across multiple subjects with different thresholds. Manual spreadsheets were fragile, app solutions were bloated. I built the tool I needed.
caseStudy.problem: Students need to maintain minimum attendance percentages (typically 75%) across 5–8 subjects simultaneously. No lightweight tool existed to track this, project future attendance, and alert when thresholds were at risk.
caseStudy.architecture: Built a web-based attendance tracking system with C++ core logic for attendance calculations, wrapped with a Node.js API layer and a clean JSON data store. The frontend provides a real-time dashboard showing each subject's current percentage, future projections, and 'safe to skip' calculations.
caseStudy.challenges: Integrating C++ core processing with Node.js async API handling. Keeping user state synced across browser restarts without authentication friction.
caseStudy.impact: Eliminated spreadsheet dependency for attendance tracking. Real-time percentage updates and future projections give students clear visibility of their academic standing.
caseStudy.lessons: The simplest ideas often create the most value. Build what you need — it will likely help others too. Bridging compiled languages with web UIs is powerful.

title: Sustainable Shopping Assistant
description: An intelligent assistant driving eco-friendly purchasing decisions through real-time data analysis. Awarded First Prize in a renowned Tech Hackathon.

caseStudy.story: A hackathon brief: solve a real-world problem in 24 hours. Most teams built dashboards. We built an intelligence layer. The goal was to help people make better purchasing decisions — not by restricting choice, but by illuminating consequences.
caseStudy.problem: Consumer purchasing decisions are made with minimal environmental context. Product labels are opaque, sustainability scores don't exist at point-of-decision, and eco-friendly alternatives are buried. The gap between intention and action is massive.
caseStudy.architecture: Built an AI-powered shopping assistant that analyzes products in real time, surfaces sustainability metrics (carbon footprint, recyclability, brand ethics scores), and intelligently recommends eco-friendly alternatives. Full-stack implementation with AI integration layer for data processing.
caseStudy.challenges: Building a production-quality AI product in 24 hours. Sourcing and normalizing sustainability data in real time. Creating an interface that made environmental data understandable and actionable for everyday consumers under competitive pressure.
caseStudy.impact: 🏆 First Prize out of all competing teams. Validated the concept that AI can bridge the intention-action gap in sustainable consumer behavior at scale.
caseStudy.lessons: Pressure is a filter — it reveals true engineering capability. The difference between winning and losing is often UX clarity, not technical complexity.

title: Real-Time Chatbot
description: A low-latency, scalable communication platform integrating ML features. Built under strict time constraints, ranking in the top 5% of 500 competitors.

caseStudy.story: 500 developers. One brief. A strict time limit. I didn't approach this as a student competing in a challenge — I approached it as an engineer solving a real infrastructure problem. That mindset shift made all the difference.
caseStudy.problem: Real-time communication systems are deceptively complex. Maintaining low latency at scale, handling connection drops gracefully, and integrating ML features without blocking the main thread — all simultaneously, all under pressure.
caseStudy.architecture: Built a scalable real-time chatbot using WebSockets for bi-directional, low-latency communication. Integrated ML capabilities for intelligent response generation and intent classification. Architected the system to be connection-resilient with automatic reconnection logic and message queue buffering.
caseStudy.challenges: Optimizing socket payload sizes for maximum throughput. Preventing thread starvation during real-time ML inference. Maintaining UI responsiveness under heavy artificial chat loads.
caseStudy.impact: Top 5% ranking among 500 developers. Demonstrated that engineering discipline, not just technical knowledge, separates good solutions from great ones.
caseStudy.lessons: Engineering under pressure reveals true skill. Architecture decisions made in the first 10 minutes define your ceiling. Calm, structured thinking beats reactive coding every time.
